title: Asset label = year make model plus the most specific identifier: Unit, then plate, then last 8 of VIN
custom_preconds: 1. One customer has four ZZAUTOTEST assets with invoices in range: (a) one with a unit number, (b) one with a plate but no unit, (c) one with only a VIN of 8+ characters, (d) one with only a VIN shorter than 8 characters.
custom_steps: 1. Expand the customer and read each asset row's label.
custom_expected:
1. Every label starts with the vehicle's year, make, and model.
  2. Asset (a) adds " · Unit {unit}".
  3. Asset (b) adds " · {plate}".
  4. Asset (c) adds " · VIN …" followed by the last 8 characters of the VIN.
  5. Asset (d) shows the whole VIN after " · VIN …" (shorter than 8).
  6. An asset with none of unit/plate/VIN gets no suffix at all.
